description: Yangnyeom Korean Fried Chicken is a beloved classic featuring incredibly crispy, double-fried chicken coated in a sticky, sweet, spicy, and savory sauce. This iconic dish offers an irresistible crunch followed by a burst of flavor, making it a perfect treat for any occasion. It is a staple in Korean cuisine, famous for its unique texture and addictive taste that keeps you coming back for more.

ingredients.item: Boneless, skinless chicken thighs or wings

instructions.title: Prepare and Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: Pat the chicken pieces dry with paper towels. In a large bowl, season the chicken with 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper, and ginger juice. Mix well and let it marinate for at least 15 minutes at room temperature, or up to 30 minutes in the refrigerator.

instructions.title: Whisk Together the Yangnyeom Sauce
instructions.text: In a small saucepan, combine gochujang, soy sauce, rice vinegar, honey or corn syrup, minced garlic, grated ginger, and sesame oil. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, for about 5 minutes until it thickens slightly. Remove from heat and set aside.

instructions.title: Prepare the Frying Batter
instructions.text: In a separate large bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 1/2 tsp salt. In another small bowl, lightly beat the egg and then add the cold water. Gradually pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients, mixing until just combined. Do not overmix; a few lumps are fine.

instructions.title: First Fry the Chicken for Crispiness
instructions.text: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep pot or Dutch oven to 325F (160C). Dip each marinated chicken piece into the batter, ensuring it is fully coated, letting any excess drip off. Carefully add the chicken to the hot oil, frying in batches to avoid overcrowding. Fry for 6-7 minutes until lightly golden and cooked through. Remove chicken and place on a wire rack.

instructions.title: Second Fry for Extra Crunch
instructions.text: Increase the oil temperature to 375F (190C). Once the oil is hot, return all the chicken to the pot for a second fry. Fry for another 3-4 minutes, or until the chicken is deeply golden brown and exceptionally crispy. This double-frying technique is key for the signature Korean fried chicken crunch.

instructions.title: Coat the Chicken with Yangnyeom Sauce
instructions.text: Immediately transfer the hot, double-fried chicken to a large mixing bowl. Pour the prepared Yangnyeom sauce over the chicken. Using tongs or a spatula, gently toss the chicken until each piece is evenly coated with the delicious sticky sauce. Work quickly to ensure an even coating while the chicken is still hot.

instructions.title: Garnish and Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Transfer the sauced chicken to a serving platter. Garnish generously with toasted sesame seeds and chopped green onions for added flavor and presentation. Serve immediately while hot and crispy for the best experience. Enjoy your homemade Yangnyeom Korean Fried Chicken!

tips: Always double-fry your chicken. The first fry cooks the chicken through, and the second fry at a higher temperature creates that incredibly crispy, shatteringly crunchy crust that is characteristic of authentic Korean fried chicken.
Use cold water for your batter. This helps create a lighter, crispier coating by inhibiting gluten development and making the starch more readily available for gelatinization during frying.

To prevent soggy chicken, coat the fried chicken in the Yangnyeom sauce right before serving. The sauce is best applied while the chicken is still hot, allowing it to adhere beautifully without making the crust soft too quickly.
